gh-gold-coast.title: Flag of the Gold Coast Colony
desc: - The Gold Coast Colony (1877–1957) used a British Blue Ensign defaced with a badge featuring an elephant and palm tree — predecessor to Ghana
- **Construction:** a Blue Ensign with the Gold Coast colonial badge in the fly half
trivia:
- The Gold Coast was Britain's colonial territory, known for gold exports
- Became Ghana in 1957, the first sub-Saharan African nation to gain independence
- The flag represented the transition to independence
